scope: Categories of parties in service, authority and control relationships; not agent roles.

categories.definition: An individual person served by the agent or responsible for a declared context.
A family or household acting as the identified collective in this context; membership and authority are separate.
A group collaborating on a shared activity or project, without requiring a separate legal organization.
An identified company, institution or other organization; this category does not require registry data.
A party outside the listed categories, explicitly named by categoryLabel; no global code is inferred.

extensionRule: Use other with categoryLabel for a local category. Adding or redefining a global category requires a new specification version.
